requirement.release_notes:
Bug Fixing: [HERO-57532] POS043 Audit Control Report | PDF can not show whole report
Descriptions:
Fix the layout issue on POS043 "Audit Control Report" when exporting to PDF with the Auto page size option. Previously, the report table was wider than the available page width on the current paper size (A3 portrait), so the rightmost column "Fiscal Number" was truncated and could not be shown completely. After this fix, the column widths are adjusted to fit within the existing paper size, and the full Fiscal Number header and values can be displayed in the PDF.
Configuration / Parameter:
Reproduce steps:
1. Open Infrasys Cloud and go to the report module.
2. Select report POS043 "Audit Control Report".
3. Enter the required report parameters (for example Business Day and Check No.) and run the report.
4. Export the result to PDF and choose the Auto page size option.
5. Open the exported PDF and check the table header on the right side.
Before the fix, the column "Fiscal Number" is cut off (for example only "Fiscal Num" is visible).
No new report parameter or system configuration is added for this fix.
Field Definition:
This case does not involve field definition. Existing columns remain the same: Time, Outlet, Employee, Action, and Fiscal Number. Only the column widths are adjusted so that Fiscal Number fits on the page.
Result / Sample:
After the fix, when POS043 is exported to PDF with the Auto page size option on the current paper size, the full "Fiscal Number" column header and values are visible within the page margins.
POS043 PDF export after fix - Fiscal Number shown completely
